visualObservation: Black-and-white print on off-white paper: long sailing ship with rowers, angular waves and a large bird above the sail. Inspected a 1200px rendering of the checksum-verified original TIFF.

replaces.reason: The old anonymous title-page reproduction has no documented photographer. It remains preserved with its original provenance; the featured Kalevala image now has a documented artist and photographer.
